description: A formula is preserved upward along embeddings between nonempty models of \(T\) if and only if it is preserved along actual nonempty substructure inclusions between nonempty models of \(T\), using the same tuple under the subtype inclusion.
signature:
Lemmatheca.ModelTheory.Preservation.extension_preserved_iff_inclusions.{u, v, w} {L : FirstOrder.Language}
  (T : L.Theory) {n : ℕ} (φ : L.Formula (Fin n)) :
  Lemmatheca.ModelTheory.Preservation.ExtensionPreserved T φ ↔
    Lemmatheca.ModelTheory.Preservation.ExtensionInclusionPreserved T φ
